title: Treasure Collect
story: Every player dribbles across the sea to a pile of treasure, grabs one piece at a time, and races it home.
setup: Line players along one touchline, each with a ball. Scatter flat cones along the far touchline as treasure.
instructions: On go, every player dribbles with the ball at their feet to the far touchline.
Collect one cone, then dribble both the ball and the cone back to the starting touchline.
Drop the cone at the start and immediately return for another.
Count each player's cones when time is called; everyone plays every round, there is no elimination.
coach_lens: Notice close touches at speed and players who look up to find an open lane rather than following the crowd.
questions: What did you do differently to go faster without losing the ball?

simplify: Shorten the distance or use fewer, closer cones.
challenge: Add a second, farther cone pile or require a two-touch stop before turning back.
low_attendance: Use a shorter field so return trips stay quick.
high_attendance: Add more cones and a second lane so no one waits to start.
limited_equipment: Use any small, safe objects in place of cones.

safety: Space players across the width of the field so dribbling lanes do not cross.
Use flat, lightweight cones only; no running with hard or edged objects.

source.title: MiniRoos Activity Guide
source.reviewer_notes: Coach-authored dribbling relay developed and field-tested with a real youth team, applying MiniRoos guidance on simple organization and maximum repetition. No source wording or artwork reproduced.
